entry.name: Generative AI Fundamentals in Python
entry.note: A short project-based path with a completion certificate, not a proctored exam
entry.audience: Developers who want hands-on practice with LLM APIs

reading.format: A learning path with hands-on practice, guided interaction, real examples, and projects.
reading.summary: This learning path teaches generative AI using Python. It starts with Python basics and moves to using large language model APIs, prompt engineering, and building automations. Completing it shows the ability to develop functional AI-powered applications and integrate AI into work.
reading.audience: It is for anyone who wants to integrate AI capabilities into their work, including professionals aiming to add AI to their toolkit.
